findings: Expanded the proposal from generic simple-graph notation to finite symmetric nonnegative weighted graphs, explicit zero-degree handling, RatioCut/Ncut indicator trace identities, and their distinct generalized/symmetric eigenproblems.

The weighted PSD/kernel identity must be proved locally: the existing published Laplacian results cover only finite unweighted simple graphs. The multi-vector trace minimization also needs a local Ky Fan argument; the published extreme-Rayleigh supplier covers only one vector. The source states Davis–Kahan but does not prove it and gives no rounding/manifold guarantee.

ESL, corrected 12th printing, §14.5.3, printed pp. 544–547: spectral clustering overview and algorithms; no consistency theorem is supplied.
